name: FRVP POC Reversal [Manual Build] [Medium]
raw_text: FRVP POC Reversal (New Batch 4, Strategy 3). Single timeframe: 1H (source's own '24-hour session volume profile' crypto-specific note). New concept: Fixed Range Volume Profile POC, drawn between the two most recent alternating confirmed swing points (own new reusable concept, concepts.fixed_range_volume_profile -- no existing Volume Profile/POC concept in this codebase used a swing-range window, only a fixed calendar-day window, so this genuinely needed a new function). Entry: price returns to an ATR-buffered POC zone (0.5x ATR14, own default) from above (long) or below (short), OR an immediate short on a clean breakdown through a POC acting as support. REQUIRED additional filter (source: 'do not trade FRVP in isolation'): a confirming Engulfing OR Hammer/pin_bar candle pattern (both existing concepts, reused directly) must fire on the SAME bar as the POC touch -- a hard AND. SL = slightly beyond the POC zone (0.65% buffer, cost_model-verified safe). TP = structure-based (swing-high/low) primary, 1:2 RR fallback (existing 'structure_or_rr' SLTP type, reused directly). Risk 1% default, no session restriction.
